headline: Katotobwe pushes for quality export products
summary: Trade and Export Development Minister Caroline Katotobwe urged Zambian manufacturers to focus on product quality, timely delivery and international market requirements. She said consistent export orders are critical to Zambia's competitiveness and export earnings.
why: Export earnings are a key source of foreign currency for many emerging economies, and Zambia's copper-heavy export base makes its trade competitiveness relevant to investors tracking African economies.
